definition: complete external 48 V supply + return loop between the board-level 48 V reference node common to both architectures (where Z1's PCB distribution meets its BGA pads) and the HVR input terminals, including the per-cell distribution to the 49 input terminals
boundary: Z2 package-internal ledger from the HVR input terminals; Z1 from the BGA pads on the PCB; board-level 48 V upstream of the common node excluded from both

HV_S0.requirement: for Z2 to keep its electrical advantage in HV-S0, R_Z2_direct_feed_loop < 9.19 mOhm

HV_S1.requirement: for Z2 to keep its electrical advantage in HV-S1, R_Z2_direct_feed_loop < 4.38 mOhm
